_comment: Roots for analysis/tools/localize.py. Copy to analysis/paths.local.json (ignored by git) and set your own directories. ${ANALYSIS} is filled automatically.
_INPUTS: exports of cluster/export_kk.jl and export_ope_edges.jl plus the run physics tables: kk/N<n>/, ope/N<n>/, physics/N<n>/ (parity.csv, ope3.toml, ...)
_OPE_ROWS: combined per-N OPE rows (CSV) of your production runs
_STAGEB_EXPORT: output of cluster/export_stageB.sbatch: half/N<n>, 11/N<n>, and imagenorm.csv
_STAGEB_RUNS: parent of the Tcc stageb out directories: half/N<n>/xy_blocks_raw.csv, 11/N<n>/xy_blocks_raw.csv
_RAWTARGET_EXPORT: exports of the rawtarget step: half/N<n>/export
